description: This file contains functions and types for filtering host entities based on lead thresholds, including logic for weighted and unweighted filtering, and exports a main async function to perform filtering based on various parameters.

classes.name: BaseUser
classes.description: Represents a user with id, email, credentials, and selected calendars.

classes.name: BaseHost
classes.description: Represents a host entity with fixed status, creation date, priority, weight, and associated user.

methods.name: filterHostsByLeadThresholdWithWeights
methods.description: Filters hosts based on booking shortfalls and a maximum lead threshold, considering weights and calibrations.

methods.name: filterHostsByLeadThresholdWithoutWeights
methods.description: Filters hosts based on booking counts and a maximum lead threshold without considering weights.

methods.name: filterHostsByLeadThreshold
methods.description: Main exported async function that filters a list of hosts based on lead threshold, event type, and routing form response, utilizing weighted or unweighted filtering as needed.
